content.text:
The robot reached the green panel at the end of the corridor and is now resting, with its motors off.

The corridor was not straight. It ran about 4 m forward, turned left, then turned left again into a short passage, and the panel is on the wall at that passage's end. I walked roughly 0.3 m short of the panel, judged from the camera; sonar read 0.36 m to each side wall. The odometry at rest is x≈0.30 m, y≈1.10 m from the start.
